# Display snippets for docs/date_time.md

--8<-- [start:now_today]
now(DT)        # DT = datetime(2026, 3, 16, 14, 30, 5, 123456)  (local, naive)
now_utc(DT)    # DT = datetime(2026, 3, 16, 13, 30, 5, 123456, 0)  (UTC offset 0)
today(D)       # D = date(2026, 3, 16)
--8<-- [end:now_today]

--8<-- [start:date_examples]
# Construct (unification with the validated term)
D is date(2026, 3, 16)       # D = date(2026, 3, 16)

# Decompose
date(Y, M, DAY) is D         # Y = 2026, M = 3, DAY = 16
--8<-- [end:date_examples]

--8<-- [start:time_examples]
time(14, 30, 0, T)      # T = time(14, 30, 0, 0)
time(H, M, S, T)      # decompose T into components
--8<-- [end:time_examples]

--8<-- [start:datetime_example]
datetime(2026, 3, 16, 14, 30, 0, DT)
# DT = datetime(2026, 3, 16, 14, 30, 0, 0)
--8<-- [end:datetime_example]

--8<-- [start:timedelta_examples]
timedelta(7, 0, TD)     # TD = timedelta(7, 0, 0)
timedelta(D, S, TD)    # decompose TD into days and seconds
--8<-- [end:timedelta_examples]

--8<-- [start:date_add_sub]
date_add(DATE, DELTA, RESULT)    # RESULT = DATE + DELTA
date_sub(DATE, DELTA, RESULT)    # RESULT = DATE - DELTA
--8<-- [end:date_add_sub]

--8<-- [start:date_diff]
date_diff(D1, D2, TD)    # TD = D1 - D2 (timedelta)
--8<-- [end:date_diff]

--8<-- [start:days_between]
days_between(A, B, N)    # N = (A - B).days (integer) — no date_diff+decompose
--8<-- [end:days_between]

--8<-- [start:date_of]
date_of(DT, D)    # D = the calendar date of DT   (datetime → date)
date_of(DT, D)    # DT = midnight of D   (date → datetime; DT unbound)
--8<-- [end:date_of]

--8<-- [start:datetime_string]
datetime_string(DT, S, "%Y-%m-%d")    # format: S = "2026-03-16"
datetime_string(DT, "2026-03-16", "%Y-%m-%d")    # parse: DT = datetime(2026, 3, 16, 0, 0, 0, 0)
--8<-- [end:datetime_string]

--8<-- [start:date_max_min]
date_max(D1, D2, M)    # M = the later of two dates — no ++max(D1, D2)
date_min(D1, D2, M)    # M = the earlier of two dates
--8<-- [end:date_max_min]

--8<-- [start:ordinal]
ordinal(D, N)    # date(2026, 3, 16) → N = 739691
ordinal(D, N)    # N = 739691 → D = date(2026, 3, 16)   (D unbound)
--8<-- [end:ordinal]

--8<-- [start:weekday]
weekday(D, DOW)    # DOW = 0 (Monday) through 6 (Sunday)
--8<-- [end:weekday]

--8<-- [start:timestamp]
timestamp(DT, TS)    # forward: TS = DT.timestamp() (float epoch)
timestamp(DT, 0)     # inverse: DT = the local datetime of epoch 0
--8<-- [end:timestamp]

--8<-- [start:iso]
datetime_string_iso(DT, S)    # S = "2026-03-16T14:30:00" / inverse parses it
date_string_iso(D, S)         # S = "2026-03-16" / inverse parses it
--8<-- [end:iso]
